text: Six months after their friend Rob is killed in a robbery [while Luke hides|wrong|failing to protect], four friends hike the Kungsleden trail in northern Sweden in his memory. When Dom injures his knee, they [leave the marked trail for a shortcut through the forest|trigger|breaking a rule] and find [a gutted moose hanging from the trees|images|animals and birds], runic symbols carved into bark, and an abandoned cabin holding an effigy of twigs with antlers for hands. Lost in the woods, [the friends|who_suffers|friends and companions] begin to quarrel as something large moves between the trees.
